summary: Frontend-only regression validation after DriverHome.js refactor (5 presentational sub-components extracted). Validated all 12 acceptance criteria on /chauffeur/home with two demo drivers (amadou.diallo clean home, jean.dupont active ride). All data-testid preserved; no behavior change detected.

issues: Google Maps JS API is loaded multiple times across the app — console error 'You have included the Google Maps JavaScript API multiple times on this page' (pre-existing, not related to this refactor)

critical_code_review_comments: DriverHome.js trimmed from 706 to ~561 lines; orchestration cleanly separated from presentation (Header, StatsRow, Map, Fab, DestModal). All data-testid preserved verbatim — refactor is safe.
Sub-components are pure presentational, no internal state, props correctly named — good.
Pre-existing issue (out of refactor scope): isLoaded constant `const { isLoaded: gmapLoaded } = { isLoaded: true };` in DriverHome.js (L52) is unused and misleading — could be removed.

Pre-existing issue (out of scope): Google Maps API is included multiple times causing console error 'gmp-* already defined' — likely separate loads in AdminGoogleMap vs places autocomplete. Consider a single loader.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor validated end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). Verified: header (online toggle En ligne <-> Hors ligne, menu/scheduled/notifications btns), 4 stat cards (stat-upcoming -> /chauffeur/reservations?filter=upcoming, stat-pending -> /chauffeur/reservations?filter=pending), earnings breakdown modal opens, scheduled-reservations-btn opens sheet, rewards-floating-btn -> /chauffeur/rewards, notifications-btn -> /chauffeur/notifications, FAB radial menu with all 6 actions (labels in French matched), fab-action-1 opens Taxi Hall modal, fab-action-2 toggles heatmap, fab-action-3 opens destination-mode-modal (dest-enable-btn correctly disabled when lat/lng empty, enabled once filled), fab-action-5 -> /chauffeur/vehicles. DriverRideFlow overlay (data-testid=driver-ride-flow) renders correctly over DriverHome for jean.dupont who has an active accepted ride.
